data.summary: Draft pricing analysis for headset-stand (synthetic demo data) under demo-direct channel rule as of 2026-10-24. At a 5% target revenue margin, the recommended undiscounted price is BRL 31.38 with contribution BRL 1.5753 and realized revenue margin 5.02%. Applying a 10% discount lowers the charged price to BRL 28.24 and contribution to BRL -1.2507, so contribution becomes negative and realized revenue margin falls to -4.43%.
assumptions: Confirmed synthetic demonstration data only: product headset-stand and rule demo-direct are both marked Demonstration with validFrom 2026-10-24 to 2026-10-26.
All revenue-based charges are applied on the charged revenue basis per the channel rule: 10% channel fee, 0% tax, 0% advertising, plus BRL 2 fixed fee.
Failure provision is included using the stored 10% failure rate and full-print retry assumption from the deterministic cost table.
Revenue margin means contribution divided by charged price; it is distinct from markup on production cost.
limitations: No current marketplace verification is available; rule is synthetic and not Shopee.
Full-print retry assumption is embedded in the deterministic table and may differ from actual production behavior.
This is a draft only; human approval is required and no price is applied or published.
